spans.boundary_evidence: VSM starts at the BlkAlloc vector at 0x4057d6. GetBMBlk returns at 0x405aa6, immediately before the FXM DeallocFile vector at 0x405aa8.

changes.change: Removed the ReadBM vector and vReadBM export added in October 1986.
changes.evidence: ReadBM begins by moving its return address from the system stack to A6. There is no jReadBM vector load or return before that body.

changes.location: Bitmap allocation, release, checks, and scan routines
changes.change: Retained the surviving instruction bodies, including the October 1985 end-of-volume scan fixes. Kept inactive debug checks as comments.
changes.evidence: All 722 bytes and 23 recorded labels match. FrBitScan subtracts D1 from D2 at 0x405a58 before returning at end of volume.

changes.change: Replaced the include wrapper with required original equates and ROM routine addresses. Preserved the procedure and added its closing ENDP. Made branch sizes and PC-relative calls explicit.
changes.evidence: The ROM uses word branches for the allocation test at 0x405840 and calls from UpdateFree, ReadBM, and NextWord. Print and load directives do not emit instructions.

verification.method: Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py assembled for the 68000, linked at 0x4057d6, and compared every emitted byte and all recorded labels against the ROM.
limits: The comparison proves emitted bytes and label positions. It does not execute file operations, disk writes, memory handling, or asynchronous operations.
External routines and trap implementations lie outside this span. Their referenced addresses and opcodes are checked here, but their implementations and runtime dispatch are not.

The original Mac Plus source and historical assembler output remain unavailable. Restored expressions and comments explain the verified ROM behavior; they do not establish the exact original spelling.
